coverage.method: Static, hash-bound local source headers and embedded histories, plus identified original author documentation. No execution, downloads, Discord data or private APIs.
limitations: Local source declarations are not proof of a current public release or runtime compatibility.
Dates are included only with an explicit source declaration and its date basis; filesystem timestamps are excluded.
Undocumented intermediate versions are not reconstructed from feature lists or diffs.
Scripts and implementation code are not published by this metadata-only enrichment.
